title: Insulator Leakage Current Prediction Using Hybrid of Particle Swarm Optimization and Gene Algorithm-Based Neural Network and Surface Spark Discharge Data
summary: A PSO/GA-optimized neural network predicted leakage current from weather and surface-discharge signals on monitored high-voltage towers, a specific grid-monitoring result. Time-separated training/test data from the monitored system and algorithm comparisons; no independent utility or long-term deployment outcome is shown.
ai_technology: ANN inputs include tower weather measurements and image-derived spark-discharge features; PSO/GA searches optimize the network.
organization: Affiliation not stated in the reviewed material

evidence.tested: The paper compares predicted and measured leakage current on 69-kV/161-kV tower data and reports improved error over baseline networks.
evidence.unknown: Time-separated training/test data from the monitored system and algorithm comparisons; no independent utility or long-term deployment outcome is shown. The source does not establish benefits beyond the reported evaluation.
